Its unique rotating blades give it impressive cutting power that will slice enemies to shreds.|Inventory|BotW}} ==Location and Uses== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 55 |durability = 50 |flammable = No |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = Yes |throw = Yes |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Ancient Bladesaw}} Ancient Bladesaws can be made by providing the [[Ancient Oven]] at the [[Akkala Ancient Tech Lab]] with 15 [[Ancient Screw]]s, 5 [[Ancient Shaft]]s, 2 [[Ancient Core]]s, and 1,000 [[Rupee]]s.{{Cite|Exchange for Ancient Bladesaw?|Ancient Oven|BotW}} They are made using [[Sheikah]] [[Ancient Technology]], and their unique rotating blades give them a strong cutting power. They are considered [[Ancient Soldier Gear]], an archetype of equipment created by [[Robbie]].{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 175}} Being made of Ancient Technology, Ancient Bladesaws will deal additional damage when used against [[Guardian]]-type [[Enemy|Enemies]], are unable to burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]], and cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. They do float on [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], however, and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_023" |Life = 50 |Power = 55 |SpHitActor = Actors with tags "TeamGuardian", "IsEffectiveAncientWeapon"; "Enemy_Ganon", "Enemy_SiteBoss_", "Enemy_Guardian_Mini_" {{List Note|All Guardians and Guardian Scouts, Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, All Ganon Blights, Guardian legs/propellers}} |SpHitRatio = 1.5 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 11 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 20 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 21 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 33 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 23 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 8 |BuyingPrice = 30 }} ==Trivia== * An unused icon and description for Ancient Bladesaws exist within the files of {{AoC}}.{{Cite Internal|quote= This two-handed sword was forged using ancient Sheikah technology.
